items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know him. His name is Abby Foster. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. That's my brother-in-law.

ctx.x: Well... Celestand... Celestand... Buddy PT... Yeah. Yeah. And... Celestand... From out of New Orleans... And let me see who is... Who is? Huh? Renee. What about Renee then? Renee used to come there. Oh. Yeah. Well... Well... Renee... I mean... New Orleans bands... That's all them old ones. Yeah. Did you all of them... All of them came... Kid Point. Yeah. They all used to be over there in Punta Cora playing. And Bebe Chinese. Maybe he's a drummer.
I know him. His name is Abby Foster.

Yeah. That's my brother-in-law. That's my... That's right. That's my sister Sadie... My husband. Yeah. Sadie and Chinese... We worked together... You know... When they was together. Celestand. Celestand, see?
